interpretation: This is a representative-date, eight-symbol development pilot, not a full-universe performance claim.
Returns use next-minute open and explicit percentage costs; no inventory, lot, queue, or portfolio-capacity replay is included.
Same-day MFE/MAE starts at the executable entry minute and requires a complete contiguous target day.
posthoc_catchup rows are retained for diagnosis and excluded from the default executable summary.
summary_overall is split by MA period; summary_overall_pooled combines all observed MA periods and is the source for pooled medians.
Every listed strategy version is retained; S3 gates are listed but skipped because their point-in-time fields are not joined.

scope.date_scope: 12 representative dates with the existing minute-MA validation categories
scope.purpose: verify finite strategy generation, causal entry resolution, forward outcome statistics, and local controls

strategy_catalog.description: Deterministic random minute within each eligible stock-hour; control only.
First minute closing at or above the previous completed hour close; no MA condition.
First close within the configured distance of the causal MA intersection; no reversal condition.
First actual intrabar touch, entered at the next minute open.
Touch or break followed by the first causal close back above the intersection.
Near-touch followed by a causal upward reversal above the intersection.
Break/touch followed by three consecutive closes above the intersection.
End-of-hour MA catch-up, retained only as a non-causal diagnostic control.
S1 reclaim with a positive prior completed-MA slope.
S1 reclaim while the causal moving averages are bullishly stacked.
S1 reclaim when no true touch occurred in the preceding configured window.
S1 reclaim with cumulative up-amount at least as large as down-amount.
Reserved for a point-in-time market-regime gate; source fields are not in the MA table.
